_note: Generic starter checklists for the demo. Each check has a weight: how much a concern on it raises the risk score. Production checklists are brand-specific and kept private (data/private/checklists.json or CHECKLISTS_PATH).

camera.check: Serial number plate or label present, intact and in the brand's usual position
Logo, model name and dial markings are crisp, evenly printed and correctly spelled
Lens mount and contacts show no heavy wear, corrosion or replacement parts
Lens glass free of visible fungus, haze, separation or deep scratches
Body panels, grip and doors match the identified model and era
Markings suggest the expected region (flag possible grey-market import)

audio.check: Serial on the unit is present and, if the box is shown, matches the box label
Logos and text are aligned, correctly spaced and the right font
Materials, stitching, headband and ear pads look like the genuine model, not cheaper substitutes
Packaging print, colors and inserts look factory-made, not reprinted
Included cables, case and accessories match what ships with the model
No signs of opened housings, replaced drivers or aftermarket parts

other_electronics.check: Serial or model label present and legible
Branding is crisp and correctly spelled
No signs of opened housings or replaced parts
